title: How to manage ATAK Tools and Toolbars
breadcrumb: How to manage ATAK Tools and Toolbars

blocks.html: Set up your ATAK toolbar so the tools you actually use are one tap away, and swap layouts fast in the field.

slides.title: Open the extra tools
slides.html: Tap the Additional Tools button beside the toolbar to reach the tools that are not on the bar. They open in a grid by default.

slides.title: Switch to list view
slides.html: In the Tools panel, tap List View to see each tool with its name in a vertical list. Easier to read when you are learning the icons.

slides.title: Switch back to grid view
slides.html: Tap Grid View to pack the tools back into a compact icon grid. Use whichever layout you find faster.

slides.title: Edit the toolbar
slides.html: Tap Edit Toolbar to enter Edit Mode. The default toolbar cannot be changed, so a copy is made for you. For a clean start instead, use Add Toolbar in the toolbars list.

slides.title: Add or remove a tool
slides.html:
In Edit Mode you can:

  • Long-press and drag a tool onto the bar to add it.
  • Drag a tool onto an occupied slot to replace it.
  • Long-press and rename a tool by its label.

slides.title: Delete a tool and save
slides.html: Drag a tool to the trashcan to delete it from the bar and send it back to the tool list. When done, tap Save and the toolbar joins your available list.

slides.title: Manage and select toolbars
slides.html:
Tap Toolbar Manager to see all your toolbars.

  • Use the radio toggle to pick the active toolbar, Edit or Delete any line, and use Export Toolbar / Import Toolbar to share a layout with another TAK user.
